candidates.name: JLL
candidates.description: Both are global leaders providing a full suite of commercial real estate services including brokerage, property management, and investment advisory.
candidates.rationale: Direct peer of CBRE: same global commercial real estate services, similar scale, overlapping clients and buying committees.

candidates.name: Colliers
candidates.description: Both operate as diversified professional services firms specializing in commercial real estate investment management and advisory.
candidates.rationale: Same commercial real estate services model, similar buyer base, and direct market peer to CBRE.

candidates.name: Hines
candidates.description: Both are major global players in real estate investment, development, and property management services.
candidates.rationale: Same commercial real estate/investment services space, similar scale and buyer base; a rep targeting CBRE would also target Hines.

candidates.name: Cushman & Wakefield
candidates.description: Both provide comprehensive commercial real estate services including leasing, capital markets, and facilities management on a global scale.
candidates.rationale: Direct peer: another global commercial real estate services firm with overlapping leasing, facilities, valuation, and asset management buyers.

candidates.name: Savills Group
candidates.description: Both offer a broad range of international property advisory services, including commercial brokerage and investment management.
candidates.rationale: Direct peer commercial real estate services firm with overlapping brokerage, advisory, and investment management clientele.

candidates.name: Newmark Group
candidates.description: Both provide integrated commercial real estate advisory and service platforms for institutional investors and corporate occupiers.
candidates.rationale: Direct commercial real estate services competitor with similar clients, offerings, and scale.

candidates.name: Knight Frank Group
candidates.description: Both are independent global real estate consultancies offering brokerage, valuation, and property management services.
candidates.rationale: Same type of global commercial real estate consultancy with overlapping services, clients, and buyer personas.

candidates.name: Marcus & Millichap
candidates.description: Both specialize in commercial real estate investment sales brokerage and advisory services across North America.
candidates.rationale: Direct commercial real estate brokerage/advisory peer serving similar property investors and owners.

candidates.name: Transwestern Hospitality Group
candidates.description: Both provide a diversified range of commercial real estate services including development, leasing, and property management.
candidates.rationale: Same commercial real estate services category; comparable business model and buyer personas.

candidates.name: Stream Realty Group
candidates.description: Both offer integrated commercial real estate services including leasing, property management, and investment development.
candidates.rationale: Same commercial real estate services model and buyer base; Stream Realty Group is a clear CBRE peer.

candidates.name: Lincoln Property Company
candidates.description: Both provide nationwide commercial real estate services spanning leasing, property management, and development.
candidates.rationale: Directly comparable commercial real estate services firm with overlapping leasing, property management, and development offerings.

candidates.name: Cresa
candidates.description: Both provide commercial real estate advisory services, with a specific focus on representing corporate occupiers.
candidates.rationale: Same commercial real estate advisory space; both serve corporate occupiers and compete for similar B2B clients.

candidates.name: Foundry Commercial LLC
candidates.description: Both offer national commercial real estate services including investment, development, and facilities management.
candidates.rationale: Same commercial real estate services model and overlapping clients across leasing, development, investment, and facilities management.

candidates.name: QuadReal Property Group
candidates.description: Both are international real estate firms focused on global investment, development, and property management.
candidates.rationale: Same commercial real estate/investment services category, similar scale and buyer base; a clear CBRE lookalike.

candidates.name: Lee & Associates NYC LLC
candidates.description: Both operate as commercial real estate brokerage and advisory firms with a broad service offering for property owners and tenants.
candidates.rationale: Same commercial real estate brokerage/advisory space, serving similar property owners and tenants; plausible direct lookalike for CBRE.

candidates.name: Trammell Crow Company
candidates.description: Both are prominent commercial real estate developers providing services to investors and occupiers.
candidates.rationale: Same commercial real estate sector; Trammell Crow is a comparable developer/service firm overlapping CBRE’s investor and occupier customer base.

candidates.name: Greystar Real Estate Partners
candidates.description: Both are major players in real estate management, though they focus heavily on the residential and multifamily property sectors.
candidates.rationale: Same broad real estate services model; Greystar and CBRE both serve property owners and tenants, with overlapping commercial real estate buyer personas.

candidates.name: Aew Sas
candidates.description: Both provide significant real estate investment management services for institutional clients.
candidates.rationale: Both are large commercial real estate investment/services firms serving institutional clients; strong overlap in business model and buyer persona.

candidates.name: Brookfield Properties
candidates.description: Both manage and develop large-scale commercial real estate assets globally.
candidates.rationale: Same commercial real estate sector, similar global scale, overlapping tenants, investors, and property management/development buyer personas.

candidates.name: BGIS Global Integrated Solutions Limited
candidates.description: Both provide integrated facility management services for commercial real estate portfolios.
candidates.rationale: Same commercial real estate services category; BGIS and CBRE both offer integrated facilities management for similar enterprise property portfolios.
